column3: the gateway is pure Go and it is not in the repository the HIP names: ai (module github.com/hanzoai/ai) serves /v1/chat/completions with model routing at ai/router/routing_policy.go and per-request metering. hanzoai/llm, which the HIP gives as its Repository, is not on disk

hsm/signer_mldsa.go:21 MLDSASigner over luxfi/crypto/mldsa and kms/sdk/go/cek.go:82 WrapCEKForMember (hybrid ML-KEM-768 + X25519 HPKE) are real. The at-rest opener cloud actually links, hanzoai/cek v0.2.3, is classical, and the AI-specific layers the HIP adds — encrypted weights, encrypted inference — have no Go

agent/agent.go serves POST /v1/agent as a single tool-calling round with per-org SQLite history. The multi-agent network routing and shared-state plane the HIP specifies are in the Python and NPM packages, not Go

cloud/plugin/billing/main.go:20 is the app binary and manifest/apps.go:173 the fleet row for /v1/billing; 48 operations resolve, including topup, subscriptions, invoices and the PSP webhook. /v1/billing/refund and POST /v1/billing/auto-recharge are absent, and the HIP itself calls each one "a target, not yet served" (§ lines 434 and 464) — so the code and the spec agree about what is missing

cloud/plugin/iam/main.go:21 serves 159 operations over /v1/iam plus the OIDC discovery roots, so the standard's core is real; six operations in the HIP-0026 § operation table are not among them — /v1/iam/get-user, add-user, update-user, delete-user, get-account, get-app-login. The service serves REST collections (/v1/iam/users, /v1/iam/applications, /v1/iam/keys) instead of the verb-per-path spelling the table carries
the Go server exists but not where the HIP puts it. ~/work/lux/kms (module github.com/luxfi/kms) holds it; kms/DEPRECATED.md retires the repository HIP-0027 names as its Repository
cloud/apps/registry/registry.go:171 serves /v1/registry as an OCI distribution surface. The hanzoai/registry repository the HIP names contains no code at all

the Go halves of the pipeline exist — cd is an ArgoCD fork that reconciles, and ci/declared.go:25 reads the pinned image out of a values file — but hanzoai/build, the repository this HIP designates, does not exist, and the workflow standard itself is YAML

go-sdk's api_*.go files are generated from cloud's OpenAPI document (header: "Code generated by OpenAPI Generator"), one file per capability. As with the Rust row, the HIP asserts Stainless and the generator in use is openapi-generator
dns is a CoreDNS fork carrying the Hanzo plugins in tree: plugin/hanzodns/{api.go,api_sync.go,cloudflare.go,kms.go,oidc.go} for API-driven records, plus plugin/geoip

cloud/plugin/functions/main.go:20 is the app binary and manifest/apps.go:217 the fleet row for /v1/functions; 11 operations resolve. The three /v1/functions/{my-function,embed-document,...} paths that do not are the HIP's worked examples of a caller-named function, not routes it fixes

~/work/lux/consensus/protocol/auth/permit.go with permit_test.go — the EIP-2612 replacement

base/plugins holds extruntime, gojavm, wasmvm and v8vm (and jsvm, pyvm, starkvm) as Go packages, plus extbench — the runtime set the HIP specifies

cloud is the reference host and satisfies the contract as written. A plugin's main links its own subsystem and the request tier and nothing else — cloud/plugin/todo/main.go:1-27 is the shape, and all 127 share it; the paths it answers are declared in cloud/manifest/apps.go and projected from the plugin's own live router into cloud/plugin/<name>/openapi.json; cloud/plugin/gen-app-cmds/main.go holds the two views in bijection, refusing a manifest row with no plugin binary and a plugin binary with no row; and the declaration is checked by asking the composed router where each path goes — cloud/manifest/router_test.go:273 TestEveryServedPathReachesTheAppThatServesIt — rather than by reading a committed document

vfs/replica/replica.go:171 PushLoop and fence.go:106 NewFencedStore give ship and hydrate with round fencing, which is what the HIP claims shipped. The generalisation is not there: hanzoai/replicate declares no replicate.Source interface and no --source flag, so the four adapters the HIP requires — sqlite-wal, zapdb-log, chain-state, generic-log — do not exist

~/work/zap/zip/load.go:399 Load mounts a plugin that starts on the first request, :135 IdleAfter evicts it when traffic stops, and :852 supervise restarts it with capped backoff. The warm ceiling is derived from the container memory request at cloud/manifest/plugin.go:243 Warm()

cloud/zapface/dispatch.go decodes a ZAP call and replays it through the whole Fiber app, and notify/internal/zaprpc/zaprpc.go carries the dot-prefixed RPC surface. Nothing implements the inter-VM thinking-chain hop the Draft is about

two of the three topologies are in the binary and the second is not the one the HIP names. cloud/cli/cluster.go has exactly two subcommands, `status` (:175) and `up` (:192): `cluster up` does fetch k3s rather than embed it (cluster.go:216 appends step{"install k3s", installK3s} when the node has none, and :294 runs `curl -sfL https://get.k3s.io | sh -`), but it installs no operator and applies no services.hanzo.ai CR — the word operator appears in that file only in comments about people. There is no `cluster init`, and no `serve` verb either: cloud/cli/cli_test.go:280 enumerates every command the binary runs itself and `serve` is absent; the host serves by default from cloud/cmd/cloud/main.go. Mode three is real at cloud/helm/cloud/Chart.yaml

gateway/cmd/admin-guard/main.go is the single ForwardAuth gate: owner == AdminOrg reaches every admin surface, a brand-org admin reaches only admin.<brand>, and a non-admin is redirected rather than refused with 403

cloud/serve.go:727 healthMux serves /healthz, /readyz (503 while draining) and /metrics on the ops listener only; config.go:310 binds :8080 from CLOUD_LISTEN and :328 binds 127.0.0.1:9090 from CLOUD_HEALTH_LISTEN — the two-listener split the HIP makes the contract

~/work/zap/zip/transport.go:65 DefaultScheme = "zap", so a bare address is ZAP and HTTP needs an explicit scheme. The conformance gate the HIP defines — zero first-party google.golang.org/grpc imports, measured by grep over .go source rather than go.mod — passes on all four repositories it names: cloud, gateway, visor and ai each return zero. The shipped exemplar is cloud/telemetry.go:79, whose defaultZapEndpoint is the collector's ZAP-native OTLP receiver rather than OTLP-HTTP :4318 or OTLP-gRPC :4317

~/work/zap/zip (module github.com/zap-proto/zip) is the framework: host.go:52 Serve builds, validates, freezes and starts the listeners, and transport.go turns transport into a scheme value under one Listen verb. cloud/cmd/cloud/main.go links it plus the manifest and nothing of the apps. Do not read hanzo/zip for this: hanzo/zip/DEPRECATED.md:1 says that fork "is dead… must not be imported", and its ZAPListen returns "zip: ZAP wire dispatch not yet implemented". The HIP's own measurement of the host is stale — it cites subsystems/subsystems.go and a clients/ plugin tree, and cloud has no subsystems/ directory

placement exists and is not consensus-backed. cloud/shardrouter.go pins an org to one pod by rendezvous hashing through hanzoai/ha, and cloud imports no luxfi/consensus package at all. There is also no cloud.Register(name, order, fn): the composition root is the generated manifest plus zip.Load

cloud/apps/web3/web3.go:151 registers typed ops on the zip router, and that one registry projects the OpenAPI document, the CLI tree and the command palette — openapi/command.go hands the rendered document to zip.CommandsFromSpec rather than deriving a second command model

cloud/plugin/eval/main.go:20 serves 16 operations, but not the surface HIP-0129 §3 fixes. The HIP is singular throughout — /v1/eval/{dataset,judge,rubric,experiment,run,score,queue,health} — and the router carries plural and different nouns: datasets, datasets/{name}, datasets/{name}/items, evaluators, rubrics, runs, scores, traces (cloud/plugin/eval/openapi.json). judge, experiment, queue and health have no route under either spelling. /v1/eval/metrics is served, which §2 says must move to o11y; the HIP records that itself at line 82 — "still served today, so the move is owed, not done"

there is no cloud/ee/ directory. The split is two repositories — cloud (145 apps/) and cloud-oss (one app, same module path) — with the product planes injected through cloud/types/types.go:311 IAMClient and its siblings. The HIP's "three tiers and stays one codebase" is not what shipped

POST /v1/event is the one ingest (cloud/apps/event) and cloud/telemetry.go installs a single tracer provider that routes co-resident or over the ZAP wire from one Send. The flat single-schema store that replaces the nine databases is not evidenced in Go

the placement unit is the ORG, not an entity group: cloud/shardrouter.go pins org to pod by highest-random-weight and orgdb.go opens per-org stores through internal/org durability. No group manifest, no sub-org locality, no splitting, no promotion

~/work/zap/zip/call.go:125 SocketPath is the one name-to-<RuntimeDir>/<name>.sock mapping and zip/load.go starts each child on its own private 0700 socket, so there is no plugin TCP port to authenticate. Identity is established once, at cloud/middleware_identity.go:228 SanitizeIdentity

cloud/apps/platform/secrets.go:135 kmsSecretRef derives orgs/<org>/platform/<app>/<KEY> and is injective in (org, app, key), which is the derivability the HIP is for. The environment coordinate is dropped (env=default), so the path in use is not the <org>/<app>/<NAME>@<env> the HIP specifies

every gate the HIP names exists as a test rather than as prose. cloud/manifest/apps.go is the one place a capability's name and prefixes are decided; cloud/manifest/number.go carries the singular-canonical rule with the plural rewritten at the door, held by number_test.go:15, :52 and :85, the last of which refuses an alias that shadows a canonical prefix; cloud/manifest/router_test.go:273 asks the composed router where every served path goes; and cloud/openapi/misfiled.txt is the shrink-only ratchet for an address answered by an app not named in it — it now carries no entries, and openapi/misfiled_test.go:54 refuses a pair the file does not carry. In this repository the gate is scripts/coverage.py over capability-coverage.txt
